info.name: TestMu AI SmartUI API Documentation Autoheal Command Logs Fetch Build Screenshots API
Fetch SmartUI build screenshots by project_id and build_id

params.name: project_name
params.description: The name of the particular project (project id can also be used)

params.name: project_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the project (project name can also be used)

params.name: build_name
params.description: Build name can also be used instead of build Id (Optional)

params.name: build_id
params.description: Fetches all the screenshots of a particular build

params.name: baseline
params.description: Fetches the screenshots of the baseline build of the project

params.name: screenshot_name
params.description: Fetches details of a specific screenshot

items.docs: This API fetches all screenshots of a particular build with comparison details. **Note:** When both `build_id` and `build_name` are provided in the request, `buildId` will be given priority over `buildName`.
